en: Izz al-Din Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad Ibn al-Athir
tr: İzzeddîn Ebü'l-Hasen Alî b. Muhammed İbnü'l-Esîr
ar: عز الدين أبو الحسن علي بن محمد ابن الأثير

description.tr: el-Kâmil, İslam tarih yazıcılığının en önemli evrensel kronolojisidir || Musul'dan yazarak Moğol tehdidine ilk elden tanıklık etti. || [Tarih notu] Moğolların Hârezm ve doğu İran'ı fethi anlatımı ünlü ağıtı içerir.
description.en: His al-Kamil is the most important universal chronicle in Islamic historiography — especially invaluable for the Crusades, Mongol invasion, and eastern Islamic lands || Writing from Mosul, he witnessed the Mongol threat firsthand. His chronicle of the fall of the Khwarezmian Empire and the Crusades remains a primary historical source. || [Historiographical note] His account of the Mongol conquest of Khwarezm and eastern Iran contains the famous lament: 'O would that my mother had never borne me.'
description.ar: كامله أهم تاريخ شامل في التأريخ الإسلامي || كتب من الموصل وشهد التهديد المغولي بنفسه
